items.rationale: The fixed unit was damaged by lightning overvoltage and was nine metres from the hob, outside the five-metre exclusion in §2.3.10(c). Under §§7.1.9–7.1.10, the 7.1 kW upgrade is payable only up to the gross cost of an equivalent 3.5 kW unit, estimated at €1,400 using Case 38.

Sections 7.1.9–7.1.11 cover removal, fitting, connection and commissioning at the pre-loss standard, but not extra labour attributable to the upgrade. Case 38 supports €478 gross for one ordinary installation.
Section 7.1.10 excludes the entire cost of a decorative console that is not needed to install the replacement; there is no allowance for the old bracket on this line.
Sections 7.1.9 and 7.1.11–7.1.12 cover ordinary carriage for the equivalent replacement, not any extra cost attributable to the larger unit or timed service. Case 38 supports €42 gross.
Section 7.1.12 excludes the entire express or timed premium unless agreed in advance or needed to prevent further loss. Neither exception is evidenced.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes the entire separately billed administration fee as contractor overhead rather than a reinstatement cost.
